choice: The helper uses only the standard library (http.server, urllib, subprocess), tests use unittest, and the page is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no build step.
context: Anyone should be able to install the sidebar without special knowledge. Apple's command line tools provide git and Python 3.9.6.
rejected: A Swift helper (no HTTP server in Foundation, needs Xcode to build); TUI or web frameworks from PyPI or Go (third-party dependencies to install); distributing a built .app (needs a paid Developer ID and notarization).
title: Python standard library only, Python 3.9 or newer
